messages.content: C大調音階中的第三個主要和弦是什麼？

function.name: get_third_chord
function.description: Calculate the third major chord in a given key. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

type.description: Type of the scale, either major or minor. Default is 'major'.

Usually we refer to the diatonic triads as I, ii, iii, etc. The third chord would be iii which is E minor (not major). But maybe they want the third chord in the progression of major chords only: I, IV, V? Actually the major chords in C major are I (C), IV (F), V (G). So the third major chord would be G major.
